title: trqp: memo query answers keyed on registry HEAD
description: Upgrade path named by the QUERY_SLOTS ponytail in git-vouch-trqp (from vouch-s9w2.1). Every request runs a full-history registry check; once one exceeds QUERY_TIMEOUT every request is a 503. Memoize query() answers in a dict keyed on (git rev-parse HEAD of the served copy, entity, at) with a short TTL (about 60 s: a key's validity at 'now' changes when its retired instant passes, with no commit). It also absorbs verify-trust's duplicate --fallback-resource query. Caveat: git vouch query judges the working tree, so a HEAD key is sound only for a clean served copy: either make that a deployment constraint (the synced copy is clean) or add git status --porcelain to the key. Build only when a registry's check time approaches QUERY_TIMEOUT.
close_reason: query --all + per-commit shared answer cache in the bridge; tests in tests/test_query.py and tests/trqp/test_trqp.py (one run per commit, dirty copy, 60 s expiry, single-flight)
